profile.headline: Software Engineer at Principal Financial Group
profile.summary:
I have a master's degree in computer science from Georgia Institute of Technology, where I gained valuable skills in machine learning and data science. My recent role was a software engineer at General Motors, where I was responsible for full lifecycle application development, coding, testing, debugging, performance tuning, documentation, and integration of software solutions in multiple languages.

In my recent roles, I have applied my skills in full stack development to create user-friendly and responsive web applications and APIs for various domains. I am passionate about solving complex problems, learning new technologies, and collaborating with diverse teams. I believe I can bring a unique perspective and experience to the organization, as I have worked in different industries, such as semiconductor manufacturing, automotive, and research. I am motivated by the opportunity to contribute to the organization's vision and goals, and to grow as a software engineer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Dynatrace · AWS CloudFormation · JUnit · Java · Spring Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated closely with high-performing cross-functional teams following Agile methodologies.
• Contributed to multiple projects leveraging microservice and micro frontend architecture using Java and TypeScript frameworks.
• Applied proficiency in Angular and Spring to actively participate in the re-architecture of the Connected Showroom application, implementing UI enhancements and API improvements that elevated usability and streamlined user flows for GM sales personnel.
• Integrated Vistex SAP software into the Global Deliver Vehicle application using Spring Integration, automating the transmission of vehicle delivery report data to dedicated SAP servers which increased efficiency in business incentive distribution to South American vehicle dealers.
• Implemented comprehensive localization and globalization strategies for applications deployed across diverse markets including North America, South America, Europe, and Asia.
• Configured and automated Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, employing blue/green deployment for seamless application updates in lower and higher environments, resulting in decreased downtime, minimal user impact, thorough testing, and immediate rollback capability.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Scaled Agile Framework · Karma · Azure DevOps Server · Microservices · Angular · Root Cause Analysis · Jasmine · Front-End Development · JavaScript · JUnit · Java · TypeScript · Spring Framework · Collaborative Problem Solving

positions.title: Test Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Optimized logistic regression model used to classify semiconductor manufacturing test failure data.
• Assisted in developing the framework of troubleshooting software designed to expedite the troubleshooting process after a test failure.
• Assisted in developing application capable of uploading failure data to a SQL database and training ML models to predict the failure types of new data.
• Collaborated with test engineers to implement changes to existing testing software which promoted more consistent semiconductor manufacturing test failure data collection.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Data Analytics · Exploratory Data Analysis · Machine Learning

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: Performed multivariable function optimization with minimization algorithms to extract key features from raw  image data obtained from semiconductor wafers during the etching phase of manufacturing. This method served as a basis for identifying and characterizing defects and irregularities.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analytics · Exploratory Data Analysis · Data Science

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Designed data visualizations for malware analysis by rendering streaming information related to network protocols, system calls, memory addresses, and all relevant statistics that are used to discover malware attacks.
• Collaborated with cybersecurity team to propose more effective and user-friendly data visualizations used to show malware activity during dynamic analysis.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Conducted energy system data analysis and developed decision tree model to predict energy consumption in commercial buildings using factors such as weather conditions and time of day.
• Research was presented in poster competitions at the Great Minds in STEM’s 29th Annual HENAAC Conference and the 2018 Emerging Researchers National Conference in STEM.

organizations.name: The National GEM Consortium
organizations.description:
GEM is a network of leading corporations, government laboratories, top universities, and top research institutions that enables qualified students from underrepresented communities to pursue graduate education in applied science and engineering.

For more information: http://www.gemfellowship.org/

organizations.name: Tau Beta Sigma National Honorary Band Sorority, Incorporated
organizations.position: Historian (2018-19) of the Iota Omicron Chapter · Apr 2018 - Present
organizations.description:
Tau Beta Sigma is a co-educational national honorary band sorority dedicated to serving college and band programs. The sorority operates primarily as a student service and leadership recognition society whose chief aim is to assist the Director of Bands in developing the leadership and enthusiasm that they require of their band. Our goals are not only to provide the band with organized and concentrated service activities, but to give our membership valid and wholesome experiences in organization, leadership, and social contacts.

For more information: https://www.tbsigma.org/
